title: Jean's Cloud House
characterDescription: young girl with curly brown hair in pigtails (bright yellow dress, curious wide eyes, hands always pointing at sky)
setting: Sunny backyard with green grass, white fence, and big fluffy white clouds floating in bright blue sky above
visual_style: Art Deco children's book illustration, geometric shapes, elegant curves, gold and cream palette, stylized clouds with decorative patterns, 1920s poster aesthetic, bold outlines, luxurious feel

pages.scene: Title page: Art Deco book cover design featuring a large elegant cloud house floating in a golden sky. Jean, a young girl with curly brown hair in pigtails wearing a bright yellow dress, stands below looking up with wonder. Geometric sunburst rays behind the cloud house. Decorative Art Deco border with fan patterns. Gold, cream, and sky blue palette. 1920s poster aesthetic, luxurious feel.

pages.text: Jean looks up at the sky. She sees a big fluffy cloud.
pages.scene: Jean, a young girl with curly brown hair in pigtails wearing a bright yellow dress, stands in a sunny backyard with green grass and white fence. She gazes upward with wide curious eyes, hands pointing at a large stylized cloud shaped like a house floating in the bright blue sky. Art Deco style with geometric shapes, bold outlines, gold accents.

pages.text: "That cloud looks like a house!" says Jean. "I want to live there."
pages.scene: Close-up of Jean with curly brown pigtails and yellow dress, mouth open in delight, eyes sparkling with wonder. Above her head, a thought bubble shows the cloud transforming into a detailed Art Deco cloud house with geometric puffy walls, decorative windows, and an elegant door. 1920s poster aesthetic, gold and cream palette.

pages.text: Jean dreams up a bedroom. The beds are soft cloud puffs. The moon peeks in the window.
pages.scene: Fantasy cloud bedroom interior with two geometric cloud beds shaped like elegant Art Deco forms. A round window with decorative sunburst frame shows a stylized crescent moon. Jean with curly brown pigtails in yellow dress bounces on one cloud bed, arms spread wide. Walls with geometric cloud patterns in gold, cream, and sky blue.

pages.text: Next, Jean adds a pool room. The pool is made of soft rain.
pages.scene: Fantastical cloud pool room with a shimmering geometric pool made of stylized raindrops in silver and blue. Jean in yellow dress sits at the pool edge, feet dangling. Cloud walls with Art Deco fan patterns surround the room. Elegant lounge chairs with curved lines. Gold and cream accents, 1920s glamour.

pages.text: Jean paints rainbow windows. Light fills every room!
pages.scene: Jean with curly brown pigtails stands on a geometric cloud stepladder, paintbrush in hand, painting a large arched window with bold rainbow stripes. Beams of colorful light stream through in geometric rays. Art Deco sunburst patterns on the cloud floor. Yellow dress, concentrated expression. Vibrant rainbow colors with gold trim.

pages.text: The kitchen has cloud puffs to eat. Jean stirs her cloud soup.
pages.scene: Art Deco cloud kitchen with geometric cloud counters and stylized cabinets featuring fan motifs. Jean in yellow dress stands at a cloud stove with elegant curved lines, stirring a pot with decorative steam wisps. Bowls of stylized cloud puffs on counter. Gold and cream palette with bold black outlines.

pages.text: A big slide goes from room to room. Whee!
pages.scene: Jean with curly brown pigtails sliding down a long curving Art Deco slide with geometric chrome rails and elegant curves. Arms up in excitement, yellow dress flowing. The slide winds through multiple stylized cloud rooms visible in the background. Bold outlines, gold accents, sense of joyful motion.

pages.text: On the roof is a garden. Cloud flowers bloom in pink and blue.
pages.scene: Rooftop cloud garden with stylized geometric flower bushes in soft pink and baby blue. Jean in yellow dress kneels among Art Deco cloud flowers with fan-shaped petals. Bright blue sky surrounds the garden with decorative cloud borders. Gold trim on planters. 1920s poster aesthetic, pastel colors.

pages.text: The living room has a big cloud couch. So soft and squishy!
pages.scene: Cozy Art Deco cloud living room with an enormous geometric cloud couch featuring elegant curves. Jean sinks into it, curly brown pigtails visible, yellow dress spread out, happy starfish shape. Stylized cloud pillows with decorative patterns, geometric rug, elegant cloud lamp with sunburst shade. Gold and cream tones.

pages.text: Jean runs inside to tell Mom. "I made a cloud house!"
pages.scene: Jean with curly brown pigtails bursting through an Art Deco doorframe into a sunny kitchen, yellow dress swishing with movement, arms outstretched. Mom stands at counter with elegant 1920s styling, turning with warm smile. Geometric tile patterns, bold outlines. Warm family moment with gold accents.

pages.text: Mom smiles. "I dreamed of cloud houses too when I was little."
pages.scene: Close-up of Mom and Jean sitting together on Art Deco furniture. Mom has nostalgic smile, one hand on heart, arm around Jean. Jean looks up with wonder, wide eyes. Stylized thought bubble above Mom shows young girl version looking at geometric clouds. Elegant gold and cream palette, warm tones.

pages.text: Jean and Mom go outside. They point at clouds and dream together.
pages.scene: Jean in yellow dress and Mom sitting side by side on geometric green grass pattern in sunny backyard, both pointing up at blue sky. Stylized Art Deco clouds float above - one shaped like a castle with geometric turrets, one like an elegant ship. White fence with decorative posts. Bold outlines, warm golden sunlight.

pages.text: "That one can be our kitchen," says Mom. "With cloud pancakes!"
pages.scene: Mom pointing enthusiastically at a geometric cloud shaped like a kitchen, Jean beside her clapping hands with delight. Above them, the cloud transforms showing stylized stacks of Art Deco cloud pancakes with gold syrup. Both figures have joyful expressions. Sunny backyard with decorative borders. 1920s poster aesthetic.

pages.text: Jean smiles big. Cloud houses are best when you share them.
pages.scene: Jean with curly brown pigtails and Mom in warm embrace in sunny backyard, both looking up with content smiles. Large Art Deco cloud house floats above, elaborate with geometric rooms visible - bedroom, pool, kitchen, garden, slide. Golden afternoon sunlight rays, white fence, green grass. Elegant heartwarming finale with gold accents.
